purpose: Website portfolio preview; representative calculations and illustrations, not a complete reproduction audit.

projects.title: Probabilistic Controlled Quantum Teleportation
projects.caption: Conditional fidelity averaged over six input states. Generated with the repository’s quick settings: 1,000 shots per circuit and five noise values, using its fixed seed sequence. This preview run uses Qiskit 2.5.2 and Aer 0.17.2.

projects.title: Assisted Quantum Teleportation under Noise
projects.caption: Conditional Haar fidelity for the Z1, XX, and XY fixed protocols under equal amplitude damping on the four resource qubits. Calculated with the repository’s evaluate function at 61 damping values; phase damping is zero.

projects.title: Gauge-Limited Quantum Thermometry
projects.caption: Eigenvalues of the four-parameter record Fisher matrix at T = 0.90, memory angle = 0.50, system–memory angle = 0.55, and assignment errors 0.02 and 0.04, using records of length six. Values below 10⁻¹² are displayed at the indicated numerical floor.

projects.title: Moiré Flat-Band Inverse Spectroscopy
projects.caption: The two central bands of the first example listed in the frozen target pool. Energies are in the repository’s dimensionless units. This is a reference-data illustration of the reconstruction target; it does not show an inverse-solver prediction. Frozen dataset case ID: 1240.

projects.title: Nonparallel-Plane Computational Holography
projects.caption: A numerical heart reconstruction on the +35° observation plane. Generated from the dual-plane example with a 128 × 128 grid, one frame, 20 main optimization steps, and two quantization-polishing steps. This is a reduced demonstration run.

projects.title: Thermo-Optical Cavity Modeling
projects.caption: Maximum temperature rise of mirror M1 in the repository’s synthetic four-mirror configuration. The demonstration extends the run to 10 seconds with one-second time steps; other configuration values are preserved. These are simulated values, not laboratory measurements.

projects.title: Exact Certificates for a Ciani Quartic Fourier Kernel
projects.caption: Numerical positions of the 12 complex roots of the specialized branch polynomial. Both exact certificate scripts were run successfully. Root positions are drawn numerically for illustration; the plot itself is not a proof of the certified identities.

projects.title: DiffractionLab
projects.caption: The repository’s Huygens–Fresnel integration compared with its Fraunhofer formula: slit width 0.1 mm, wavelength 632.8 nm, distance 1 m, 512 slit samples, 801 screen positions, and no added noise. Both curves use peak-normalized intensity.

projects.title: XJTU Cover Letter Template
projects.caption: The compiled one-page cover-letter example, showing the template’s actual layout and sample text.
projects.source: User-provided compiled template PDF; one A4 page.
